valueNote: Adds a clear Ferrero-to-Lopez coaching timeline, with the two sources' different start dates and the ATP profile still listing Ferrero shown side by side. Most tournament facts are restated from ATP and RFET pages, but the timeline context is more than the top results give.
summary: All round-1 rejection points are fixed: the Tokyo level, the Lopez 'in Form' wording, the editorial indoor-record clause, the 'in seiner Karriere' qualifier and the 'widersprechen sich' framing. Every claim in the body, summary, knownFor, FAQ and person_json now checks against the opened sources. Two points rest on re-fetch wording that differed from round 1 and should be checked by a human editor on the live pages: the Tokyo 2026 'ATP 500' label (RFET re-fetch quotes 'ATP 500 de Tokio') and the Nitto hard/indoor records being career totals. Outdated check: the Vienna first-round match was not yet played as of 27 Oct 2026, and the No. 3 ranking and Race to Turin position are not contradicted by any later source found in web search.
